text: ok yeah silence it, its not doing anything useful unless like you said it itself actually changes
resolution: Silenced the chatty [live-regions] bind summary in cart/editor/world/livePush.ts. pushLiveMaterialRegions still re-binds regions on every world push (the bind is cheap host-side data and must land after reloads), but the console.warn now only fires when the bind set actually changes — a module-level signature of every bind's key, regionId, face count, and material data is compared against the last logged one. Placing unrelated props no longer prints the cylinder slot-0 line every click; editing the live material params or adding/removing a live-material model logs once. Host-refused binds still console.error unconditionally.
